headline: Public Law 116-125 authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to honor U.S. Merchant Mariners of World War II and sends the medal to the American Merchant Marine Museum for display.
what_it_does: The law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to recognize the service of U.S. Merchant Mariners during World War II. After the medal is awarded, it goes to the American Merchant Marine Museum, where it can be displayed and used for research.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 13, 2020.
